| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Wavelet** `wavelet` | Symlet 4 (sym4) | Haar, Daubechies 2 (db2), Daubechies 4 (db4), Daubechies 8 (db8), Symlet 4 (sym4), Symlet 8 (sym8), Coiflet 1 (coif1), Coiflet 3 (coif3) | The orthogonal wavelet. Its filter taps come from PyWavelets. |
| **Levels** `levels` | 3 | 1 to 8 | How many times the transform splits the low-pass part. It is capped at the deepest level the image size allows. |
| **Threshold rule** `rule` | BayesShrink | VisuShrink (universal), BayesShrink, SureShrink, Fixed threshold | How the threshold T is chosen. VisuShrink uses one threshold for all subbands. BayesShrink and SureShrink choose one for each subband. |
| **Shrink rule** `mode` | Soft | Soft, Hard | Soft thresholding sets small coefficients to 0 and moves the others toward 0 by T. Hard thresholding sets small coefficients to 0 and keeps the others. |
| **Noise sigma** `sigma` | 0 | 0 to 100 | The standard deviation of the noise, in pixel values. 0 estimates it from the finest diagonal details. |
| **Threshold** `threshold` | 20 | 0 to 255 | The threshold T in pixel values, for the fixed threshold rule only. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
